device_bridge: mock callback contract; no physical device

checks.name: Header lower corners center upward and navigation upper corners center downward, both toward the horizontal middle
Browser preview is explicitly labelled and device actions are disabled
All four pages and expanded settings fit 320/390/768/1280 px
FAFAFA base surfaces, sticky header and simplified settings/log pages
Status, Settings and Logs share the same header height on phone and desktop widths
Display-only status graphic, no manual refresh or interval label, separate text and connector lanes
Action buttons are filled and aligned; bottom navigation remains transparent
About hides the shared header and presents its own icon and title without punctuation
Current author, links, GPL and bottom-only upstream credit
Automatic update line precedes project links; free optional support opens local QR codes with close, Escape and focus restoration
Update checks handle current/new versions, reject foreign download URLs and recover after network failure
KernelSU pause/resume controls work from Settings and are absent from the status canvas
Small readings action shares the story title row below the phone
Borderless fixed status page fits four phone viewports; details dialog closes by button or Escape
Sensor units, processing relationship, continuous visible refresh and no redundant title/copy row
Scene relations render actual paired/unilateral states, including elapsed holds and honest on-change age
Background visibility stops reads and foreground return refreshes immediately
UI observation lease is renewed only by visible status reads and stops in the background
Wake observation takes priority over stale sensor wording and explains when the engine will take over
Diagram uses real target/current coordinates and responds to source, thermal, sunlight, hold and stale flags
Status polling stops while another page is being viewed
Scene adaptation retains the saved configuration key, defaults on and can be changed through the boolean editor
All fields have recommendations; boolean/text modal validation and defaults work
Settings rows use compact spacing while retaining hints, recommendations and value editors
Slider modal cancel/confirm, recommendations and keyboard-safe footer/dialog
Actual shell commands preserve bytes, atomically save, reject genuine conflicts and report comparison failures separately
UTF-8 config save and readback preserve exact bytes despite bridge newline trimming and CRLF conversion
Existing CRLF and missing-final-newline configurations can both be edited and saved
Invalid temperature relationship and sunlight duration are rejected without writes
Atomic conflict and reload failure never show a false success
Logs lead with recent content, aligned refresh/copy/export actions and collapsed diagnostics
State read failure clears stale metrics; logs render as text, never HTML
Log copy, full-current-log export to active-user Downloads and export failure reporting
Log policy is persisted through validated control arguments
About intro describes the module without process markers or donation claims
External URLs resolve a generic web handler and launch an explicit browser, without MAIN selectors
Site/blog/license links, resolver fallback, missing browser and launch failures preserve the WebUI
Engine controls lead Settings; learning is inside the curve editor, defaults on and unrelated saves preserve curve learning
Curve learning can be disabled without resetting learned points
Real Bash preset writes preserve UTF-8, create/delete atomically, reject concurrent changes and clean temporary files
Curve anchors edit/save with monotonic validation; named persistent presets save/load/delete without applying the engine configuration
Original sensor and conditioned control inputs stay distinct; complete configured curve and exact linear sub-1% target marker render together
Thermal UI distinguishes disabled, scanning, absent, unreadable, suspect and trusted sources; debounce confirmation explains its role
Timestamped logs initially scroll to latest, preserve manual scroll-up and follow bottom while watching new lines
No JavaScript runtime errors in preview or device bridge flows
